instruction: Convert the LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet into an interactive 3D model and view it in Blender.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Calc does not support exporting spreadsheets as 3D models. There is no built-in conversion from spreadsheet data to 3D geometry formats.
